shared_elements: horizontal band of repeating ornament framing a central register
stacked registers separated by plain dividing lines
possible small human figure/hand element in the central register
justification: Both surfaces are organised as horizontal registers in which a central figured/decorated strip is bounded above and below by continuous bands of small repeated motifs (rosettes in A, petal/pendant and zigzag bands in B), which is the strongest correspondence. However, A's central register is filled with a procession of naturalistically detailed standing human figures in profile holding hands and objects, whereas B's content is almost entirely abstract geometric and vegetal patterning with at most a tiny schematic figural element, so the actual subject matter differs fundamentally.
